negative_examples.phenomenon: 形状记忆合金马氏体逆变
negative_examples.reason: Scheffer fold-bifurcation class is characterized by saddle-node bifurcation in a single slow variable with positive feedback giving bistability + critical slowing down. (1) 果胶凝胶/淀粉糊化 are percolation-type gelation transitions (Flory-Stockmayer), not saddle-node fold — they are continuous (second-order) network connectivity transitions. (2) 形状记忆合金马氏体逆变 is a martensitic first-order transition driven by elastic+transformation strain compatibility, not by an ecological-type slow-fast bistability; the mathematical form is Ginzburg-Landau φ⁶ with strain coupling, not r-bx+x²/(h²+x²). (3) 热障涂层热应力分岔 is a buckling/delamination instability, not a bistable attractor flip.
